headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2025, back when Kazuchika Okada vs. Bandido clashed for the AEW Unified Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.44 ? a real highlight of the night. Okada dodged a Rainmaker attempt from Bandido before countering with his own to retain the AEW Unified Championship, as a smiling Okada set off tension with Don Callis Family member Takeshita.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when it was Briscoe, Cassidy & Strong's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.88.
